name: [Ontology for Data Agent] - Ontology integration with Data Agent
description: Fabric IQ Ontology empowers the Data Agent to query and reason over your business data using natural language, grounded in a well-defined semantic model. Users can ask complex analytical questions and receive trustworthy, explainable answers with citations that trace back to the underlying ontology and data sources — giving teams confidence that insights are accurate, verifiable, and rooted in the true structure of their enterprise data.
